domain_nodes.mission: Establish the size, identity, quality, recency, growth, activation and economic relevance of the relationship asset without equating raw contacts with true relationships.
domain_nodes.state_label: The combined SOI contains 392 contacts, about half attributed to the operator, with roughly 50 personal relationships believed top-of-mind. The database is an incomplete spreadsheet without email completion or segmentation and receives outside update support. Postcards recur every five to six weeks while personal outreach is random and acknowledged as under-systematized.

domain_nodes.mission: Determine whether qualified opportunity supply is sufficient for the stated goals and how the operator actually creates it across a governed source portfolio.
domain_nodes.state_label: The operator reports insufficient current opportunity generation. SOI contact and local networking are available lanes; other named lanes are intentions rather than evidenced engines. Current evidence cannot separate generation scarcity from capture, qualification, follow-up, or market effects.

domain_nodes.mission: Locate where governed opportunity is captured, contacted, nurtured, qualified, appointed, presented, agreed, transacted and returned to relationship value—or leaks.
domain_nodes.state_label: The governed evidence makes follow-up / conversion material, but the accepted state does not establish a separate conclusion for it.

domain_nodes.mission: Determine whether recurring lead, client, listing, buyer, transaction and post-close work is produced by inspectable systems rather than memory or heroic effort.
domain_nodes.state_label: Listing, buyer, lead, transaction, and recruiting steps are articulated. The operator retains primary transaction follow-through while using coordinator support as needed. Operational repeatability is unverified despite the operator describing current processes as working.

domain_nodes.mission: Establish who owns which standards, how execution is inspected, how correction occurs and where accountability is absent or leader-dependent.
domain_nodes.state_label: Coaching is present for business development and recruiting. Routine business execution is primarily self-accountable or unowned. The operator attributes limitation to organization, time management, and distraction.

domain_nodes.mission: Reconcile what the business produces economically across units, volume, GCI/revenue, expenses, contribution, profit, cash, owner income and reinvestment capacity.
domain_nodes.state_label: Units, sales volume, gross, and expenses are reported for incompletely defined periods. Reported units and volume imply an average sale price below the separately stated average. Agent net, owner compensation, owner profit, cash, reserves, and contribution by source or closing are not established.

domain_nodes.mission: Determine present capacity, owner dependence, role/decision ownership, team economics and whether leverage is operationally/economically earned.
domain_nodes.state_label: Profit and business contribution are reported as equal while the operator reports performing most team work. The business partner participates in joint lead and client follow-up. No person-level team synthesis is authorized for the reported partner relationship.

domain_nodes.mission: Bind the present residential business model, desired operating future, strategic choices and goal economics so all other territories are interpreted relative to the business being built.
domain_nodes.state_label: The operator has explicit production, delegation, team, and office goals across multiple horizons. The reported current team pace is below the near-term monthly closing target. The growth plan lacks evidenced demand, economics, role, and process gates.

destinations.name: YOUR BUSINESS NOW
destinations.mission: See the actual current business system, its assets, vulnerabilities and honest gaps.

destinations.name: WHAT’S DRIVING IT
destinations.mission: Understand the supported causal mechanisms, alternatives and conditions that would change the view.

destinations.name: WHERE IT’S HEADING
destinations.mission: Compare five conditional trajectories using deterministic relative-support weights, not probabilities.

destinations.name: WHAT CHANGES IT
destinations.mission: See the selected bounded intervention and the mechanism it is designed to test.

destinations.name: HOW YOU EXECUTE IT
destinations.mission: Translate the move into prerequisites, ownership, steps, proof and execution adjustments.

destinations.name: WHY WE BELIEVE IT
destinations.mission: Separate what is known, inferred, missing and contradicted, with explicit mind-change conditions.

Leader-Centered Continuity. Current configuration persists without governed direction-of-travel evidence. Relative support: 27 of 100.

Bounded Support-Layer Emergence. Existing joint follow-up, database-update support, coaching, and coordinator or title assistance form an early distributed support layer; recurring ownership and operator relief remain unverified. Relative support: 15 of 100.

Governed Relationship and Operating Core. Governed relationship records and next actions combine with source-stage measurement, explicit ownership, and recurring review to alter the current operating mechanisms. Relative support: 20 of 100.

Transferable Multi-Agent Operating Model. After the governed core proves repeatability and economics, validated demand lanes and gated capacity additions support a producer-to-manager transition. Relative support: 12 of 100.

Centralization Deepens Under Premature Growth. Growth commitments outrun relationship governance, measurement, role clarity, and economic readiness while operator coordination load increases. Relative support: 26 of 100.
End-to-end ownership transfer trial. Transfer one recurring workflow with explicit decision rights, quality boundaries, exception rules, and inspected completion.
Requested organization, delegation, and team growth make transferability the immediate capacity question.

Evidence that would support the move: Workflow continuity persists across repeated cycles without hidden operator rescue. Released operator capacity is demonstrably redirected to relationship, system, or accountability work. Role and decision records support a clearer leverage-readiness judgment.

Evidence that would challenge the move: Nominal delegation leaves decisions and follow-through with the operator. Rescue work or quality failures expand. Operator capacity is neither released nor redirected.
Select one recurring workflow that currently returns to the operator.
Map its start, finish, standard, decision rights, exceptions, and evidence requirements.
Authorize controlled shadow-to-independent execution with operator involvement limited to defined exceptions.
Inspect commitments, outcomes, rescues, and intervention causes.
Retain, revise, or revert the transfer based on observed fidelity.
Pilot one workflow before extending the ownership model.
Predefine check-ins and escalation before workload pressure rises.
Treat the workflow as a seat-boundary test rather than proof of managerial readiness.
